`final class NodeScrollEvent.Post<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeScrollEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeScrollEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeScrollEvent.java)

The event of `onScroll`, `onScrollToEnd` and `onScrollEndReached`, which fires once a node scrolled.

## Description

[`Node.onScroll`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onScroll) fires when the target offset changes, [`Node.onScrollToEnd`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onScrollToEnd) when a scroll heads for the end of the content, and [`Node.onScrollEndReached`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onScrollEndReached) when the content arrives there.
